showAsCard.description:
If true, specifies that the children container will be given the c3-card css class.
This means it will be given a background, rounded edges, box-shadow, and other css properties
associated with the c3-card class.

showTitle.description: If true, specifies that the current step's title will be shown as a header title for the children container.

showSubtitle.description: If true, specifies that the current step's subtitle will be shown as a header subtitle for the children container.

showBanner.description:
If true, specifies that a banner will be shown at the top of the children container. The step must specify the
content of the banner for the banner to be shown (one of {@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorStep#bannerTitle} and
{@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorStep#bannerSubtitle} must be set).

title: Specifies presentational properties for the children container of a {@link UiSdlProgressIndicator}.
name: UiSdlProgressIndicatorChildrenContainerSettings
